info.name: Coverpress — RAWG, SteamGridDB and the local API
info.description: The exact upstream calls Coverpress makes to RAWG and SteamGridDB, and its own local API, including reruns. Set rawgKey and sgdbKey (the same values as RAWG_KEY and SGDB_KEY in .env). The requests save the ids they return, so run them in order. SteamGridDB is personal, non-commercial use only.

item.name: RAWG (rawg.io/apidocs)
item.description: The exact RAWG calls Coverpress makes (lib/sources.mjs). Free tier: 20,000 requests a month; the key goes in the query string. Coverpress caches every game under data/art/cache/, so a rerun costs no RAWG calls.

request.description: What the library shows with an empty search. 187 = PS5, 18 = PS4.
Search as the library does it. Saves the first hit's id into rawgGameId.
Metadata, description (back-cover copy fallback), background_image and background_image_additional (front-art candidates).
Every screenshot: front-art candidates and the three back-panel shots. Reruns rotate which ones are used.

item.name: SteamGridDB (steamgriddb.com/profile/preferences/api)
item.description: The exact SteamGridDB calls Coverpress makes (lib/sources.mjs), with the Bearer key from SGDB_KEY. Personal, non-commercial use only. Logo lockups (white_logo) are excluded because the renderer prints its own title; some art may still carry a logo, so check before printing.

request.description: Coverpress takes the exact-name match, else the first result. Saves it into sgdbGameId.
The grids a new cover chooses from.

item.name: Portrait grids, next page (what a rerun fetches)

request.description: When every grid a cover knows has been used, Run again asks for the next page and adds it to the cache. Change sgdbPage (1, 2, …) to walk the pages. A short page means the list has run out.
Wide banners: candidates for the front (heavy crop) and the spine.

item.name: Coverpress local API (npm run dev)
item.description: The app's own API on 127.0.0.1:3000. Run the requests top to bottom: each one saves the ids the next needs (rawgGameId, artId, coverId, renderId). Requests without an Origin header are allowed, so Postman works as is.

request.description: Coverpress's own search (cached 10 minutes). Saves the first game's id.
Metadata, copy and existing covers for a game.
Every candidate with width, height, kind and fit (0–100), best first. Saves the best id into artId.
Ollama drafts it (cached); falls back to RAWG's description.
Your saved prompt, or llama3.2's draft.
Needs GEMINI_API_KEY. Billed per image by Google.
Creates the cover (or re-runs the existing one for this game + platform) and queues every pipeline step. Saves coverId.
One cover per game + platform; existing ones get a new variant.
Steps, log lines, render URLs and QC. Poll every second while it runs.

Run again. Picks unused art from a different source than last time (RAWG ↔ SteamGridDB ↔ AI), fetches SteamGridDB's next page when every grid is used, rotates the screenshots, redrafts the copy and varies the layout.
Re-render the stored art and copy, e.g. after adjusting.
The review board's Run again for covers that are not approved.
Every version, newest first, with the art each used. Saves the newest renderId.
Zoom, offsets (mm) and title size (mm). Same art, new version.
Approve the version in renderId; that one prints.
Every cover across shelves, each with its versions.
Recent runs and the active count.
